subject: Vendor payment setup - Atlas Robotics (ACH vs Wire, invoicing)
messages:
From: Paul Reynolds <paul.reynolds@atlas-robotics.com>

Cc: Elena Morales <elena.morales@atlas-robotics.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: Vendor setup: banking details + invoicing preferences

Hi Priya,

Thanks for moving this forward. We're excited to get Atlas set up as a vendor for Redwood. A couple of quick items we need to confirm from your side so Finance can finish the onboarding: 

- Preferred payment methods: ACH is preferred for us, but we can accept wire on request. Please confirm whether Redwood can accept ACH for USD payments and whether there are any limits/requirements on daily ACH batches.
- Payment terms: what is Redwood's standard? We typically see Net30 but some customers run Net45. Please confirm Redwood's default and whether PO numbers are required on invoices.
- Remittance: what remittance email should invoices/payments confirmations be sent to? Does Redwood prefer invoice submission to an AP email or via a vendor portal?
- Banking details: we will provide ours but want to ensure the channel is acceptable (secure upload or DocuSign).

Attached: Atlas_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.xlsx, Atlas_W9.pdf. If you can share your vendor setup form or vendor ID requirements, that would speed things up.

Best,
Paul Reynolds
Head of Procurement, Atlas Robotics
paul.reynolds@atlas-robotics.com
+1 415-555-0123
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Paul Reynolds <paul.reynolds@atlas-robotics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 18:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Vendor setup: banking details + invoicing preferences

Paul — thanks for the clear checklist and the attachments. A few quick responses and requests so we can get you into our accounting system: 

- Payment method: Redwood supports ACH (USD) to domestic US accounts by default and can do wires for one-off or urgent payments. ACH is preferred for standard recurring invoices; wires are processed with additional internal approvals.
- Payment terms: our standard is Net30. Exceptions can be considered (Net45) for strategic partners but require Finance approval. Please confirm which term you prefer and whether Net30 is acceptable to Atlas.
- PO requirement: Redwood requires a PO number for any invoices over $10,000. For smaller invoices, an invoice referencing the contract/quote is usually OK. Please confirm whether Atlas expects us to generate POs for all invoices.
- Remittance & invoice submission: we prefer invoices sent to ap@redwood.ai. We also support vendor portal uploads — if you want portal access, request it in the onboarding form and we'll provision it. Remittance confirmations are sent to the same email by default.
- Secure transfer: please upload your completed onboarding form and W9 via the Drive link in the Doc (or send via DocuSign). For bank account details, we prefer they come in the onboarding form or via DocuSign for auditability.

Next steps from our side: I'll start a vendor setup request with Finance (Laura CC'd). Marissa, can you flag the Atlas opportunity and add the vendor note in CRM so we tie invoices to the deal?

Thanks — I'll follow up once Finance confirms setup.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Vendor Ops / Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
